An attacker could potentially manipulate the 'now' parameter to extend session validity beyond the intended TTL. The code should use a strict comparison with a margin of error or ensure time is not manipulated by the caller.", "severity": "medium", "location": "auth/tokens.py:21"}], "NOT_REACHED": ["auth/__init__.py", "auth/utils.py", "auth/models.py", "auth/legacy/old_handler.py"]}
